author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Update the code in CMSSW for alpaka 2.2.0:
  - migrate from alpaka traits (_e.g._ `isQueue<TQueue>`) to concepts (_e.g._ `concepts::Queue<TQueue>`)
  - simplify calls to `alpaka::memcpy`

Technical only, no changes expected.

#### PR validation:

None.
title: Various updates for alpaka 2.2.0
